verdicts.reason: The statute and its date are confirmed. FAR Case 2023-008 was proposed in the Federal Register on 2026-02-17, takes effect 2027-12-23 and covers SMIC, CXMT and YMTC plus products that incorporate their chips. Comments closed 2026-04-20, and no final rule was found (via search snippets). But the card's fatal flaw has largely materialized. The proposed rule is a certification (52.240-XX/-YY) after a 'reasonable inquiry', with no third-party audit, no affirmative duty to prove compliance, and a safe harbor for reasonable reliance on supplier certifications under 5949(h).
